title: Adumbration

inlines.v: ADUMBRA'TION, noun 1. The act of making a shadow or faint resemblance. 2. A faint sketch; an imperfect representation of a thing. 3. In heraldry, the shadow only of a figure, outlined, and painted of a color darker than the field.
